04559 Micpereth {mis-peh'-reth}

源自 04457; 陰性專有名詞

欽定本 - Mispereth 1; 1

米斯毗列 = "數目"
1)跟隨所羅巴伯被擄歸回者之一 (#尼7:7|)
   1a) 也可以作 '米斯拔'  (SNH04558)

04559 Micpereth {mis-peh'-reth}

from 04437;; n pr f

AV - Mispereth 1; 1

Mispereth = "number"
1) one of those who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
   1a) also 'Mispar'
